reason: Charging ₹99 for a tiny 100g tube amounts to nearly ₹1,000 per kilo for basic chutney. When fresh coriander costs ₹10 at the mandi and standard brands sell 100g for ₹20-35, this pricing is completely unjustified.
objection: The price per gram is absurdly inflated for an everyday Indian condiment that my family consumes in bulk.
would_change_my_mind: A family pack of 300g or 400g priced under ₹120 to bring the cost per gram down to reasonable levels.
